children: Ether.fi has announced that cashback rewards will now be funded in ETHFI, purchased through programmatic buybacks from the protocol's revenue streams. The update introduces boosted categories offering up to 30% back, instant membership upgrades via staking ETHFI, and a $5 minimum for claims with a 7-day clearing period.

The change ties token demand directly to protocol revenue, since cashback payouts are backed by open-market ETHFI purchases rather than pre-allocated reserves. Staking requirements for tier upgrades add a lockup component to the same flow.
Buyback volumes and staking balances are the observable measures of how much revenue is recycled into ETHFI demand over time.

title: Ether.fi: Cashback rewards shift to ETHFI funded by programmatic buybacks - 11 Sep 2026
